title: Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia 2026 Bandung Review: The Hydration-Brand 21K
seo_title: Pocari Sweat Run Bandung 2026 Review | Indonesia Race
meta_description: The Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia 2026 Bandung: September 19 in Bandung. 21K and 10K from Indonesia's favorite sports drink — registration open.
dek: Set for 19 September 2026 in Bandung, this Pocari Sweat-branded run offers 21K and 10K distances with registration open. A hydration-brand Indonesian race in West Java's cool highland city.
verdict: Pocari Sweat Run Indonesia Bandung brings Japan's iconic sports drink brand to West Java's highland capital. Two distances (21K, 10K) with registration open. Bandung's elevation (roughly 700m) means cooler temperatures than Jakarta or Surabaya — a genuine climate advantage for an Indonesian road race. The Pocari Sweat brand association means well-stocked hydration stations (predictably) and professionally produced race merchandise. September in Bandung is the tail of the dry season. A solid, brand-backed West Java half marathon.
